svg.title: Events: named sessions and live delivery
svg.desc: Terminal commands, local services, peer Pi sessions and Jobs watchers publish directly to subscriber sockets. Friendly names resolve through a persistent local registry to a session UUID and then a live attachment. Each subscriber dispatches matching topics to a handler, a display notification or a model follow-up. There is no central broker or offline event queue. Agent assignment and result control remains a separate RPC path.
svg.text: Events — direct, local delivery
Same-user publishers and subscribers. No central broker.
Publishers
Terminal commands and local services
Peer Pi sessions
Jobs watcher, after querying Pueue
send NAME · publish --topic TOPIC
Resolve an address
names.json: albacore → saved-session UUID
Runtime record: UUID → socket + attachment capability
Names persist. Sockets and pending notifications do not.
send binds one attachment before reading stdin.
direct Unix-socket frame
Subscriber: albacore
Validate capability, attachment and subscribed topic.
Dispatch to a handler, a UI notification or a follow-up.
Idle Pi can wake. Busy follow-ups wait for a safe boundary.
Acknowledgment means accepted, not processed by the model.
Other subscribers
Other Pi sessions or CLI listeners
Explicit broadcast sends each
matching subscriber its own copy.
No mailbox, replay or implicit orchestration
Offline or ambiguous named targets fail. No automatic retry against replacement attachments.
Parent/child agent assignments and authoritative results stay on their separate RPC/supervisor path.
External text is data, not approval. Names and source labels do not authenticate publishers.
